description: Search US federal contracts ($1M+) ending within 12 months, likely to be re-competed. Returns count, total potential value and the first 10 matches (all rows with a Radar Pro key). Data: USAspending.gov.

key.description: Optional Radar Pro key: every matching row instead of the first 10

months.description: Only contracts whose current end date is within this many months (1-12)

naics.description: NAICS codes, comma-separated (3-6 digits), e.g. 541512. Pass "" to search by agency only.

setaside.description: Set-aside text to match, e.g. 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone

name: search_recompetes
title: Awardtide: search expiring federal contracts
